description: React component for the header section of a web application, managing navigation and menu display based on application state and user interaction.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: React component class for rendering the header with navigation and menu controls.

methods.name: handleClickOutside
methods.description: Handles clicks outside the menu to close it if open.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays the menu and adds event listener for outside clicks.

methods.name: hideMenu
methods.description: Hides the menu and removes outside click event listener.
